title: Daquales! HorrorPack!
description: this modpack adds 8 terrifying monsters and every monster is always watching and stalking wherever you go. with anomalies that stalk you and dissapear.
body:
hi my friend created this modpack very scary warning


A brutal Forge 1.20.1 horror survival modpack built to make Minecraft feel unsafe again.

This pack throws you into a world filled with stalking creatures, cave predators, distorted entities, psychological horror, disturbing ambience, and constant paranoia. Every cave feels wrong. Every sound matters. Sometimes the monsters don’t even attack immediately — they just watch.

You are never truly alone.

Main Horror Mods Included
The Man From The Fog
A relentless entity inspired by urban horror that stalks players in darkness and strikes when least expected.
From The Caves
Adds terrifying cave encounters, disturbing sounds, and creatures that make mining dangerous again.
Siren Head
The massive siren creature roams the world with horrifying audio cues and long-distance hunting.
The One Who Watches
You may notice something staring at you from afar before it disappears into the dark.
The Knocker
A creature that manipulates sound and fear to lure players deeper underground.
Goat Man
A fast and aggressive predator inspired by cryptid horror.
Boiled One Reimagined
Disturbing visuals and terrifying encounters based on internet horror.
The Ravenous
Adds violent hostile entities built around panic and survival.
Mutant Monsters
Deadlier mutated versions of classic Minecraft mobs.
World & Atmosphere

The world generation is expanded with massive structures, dangerous exploration, darker caves, and eerie environments designed to increase tension during exploration.

The modpack focuses heavily on:

psychological horror
cave terror
stalking entities
survival pressure
loud jumpscares
oppressive atmosphere
unpredictable encounters
Recommended Experience
Play with friends for maximum chaos
Use headphones
Keep brightness low
Do NOT assume caves are safe
Running away is sometimes smarter than fighting
Warning

This modpack contains:

loud audio
jumpscares
disturbing entities
flashing visuals
aggressive monster AI
possible emotional damage after hearing footsteps behind you in a cave
